text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $62.7K while Ethereum is marginally softer, suggesting cautious positioning among major assets as the market sits in extreme fear territory. BTC dominance at 55.6% and moderate daily volume of $54B indicate reduced conviction across both majors, though altcoins like BNB are showing relative outperformance. The fear index has ticked up 5 points over the week, signaling deepening uncertainty rather than capitulation, leaving the market vulnerable to further consolidation or sharp moves in either direction.
